name: Stonebrook Industrial Fund III

terms.couponNote: Quarterly, from rent. Stated as a preferred return in the waterfall.
terms.carry: 20% over the preferred, then 50/50 above a 15% IRR

liquidity.source: Sale of the portfolio at the end

structure: Nine stabilised light-industrial buildings on long leases, at 55% loan-to-value. Because it quotes a preferred return it is priced on the income table rather than the real-estate equity one.

sections.title: What it is
sections.body: Stabilised industrial property let on long leases, paying a quarterly preferred return out of rent.
